novels.title: Gaon Wapas
novels.author: Rahasya Original
novels.novel_logline: City girl Tanvi returns to her village — old secrets, new betrayals, and a family that is not what it seems.
novels.story_summary: Tanvi (24, black tee, denim shorts, long black hair, crossbody bag) returns from Delhi to her UP village. Parents: father in cream shirt, mother in green saree. Ex Karan still lives nearby. Kirana owner spreads gossip. Hidden affair, pregnancy rumor, blackmail phone calls. Crime-thriller tone, Instagram-safe suggestive dialogue only.
novels.retention_strategy: Hook with shock → village gossip → secret messages → who is lying → cliffhanger every episode. Same 4 characters every panel.

novels.title: Doosri Call
novels.author: Rahasya Original
novels.novel_logline: Priya finds a second phone in her husband's drawer — every missed call hides another woman.
novels.story_summary: Priya and Rohan, Delhi middle-class couple. Priya discovers secret chats. Sister-in-law may be involved. Blackmail photos. Police complaint setup. Affair as plot engine, no explicit scenes.
novels.retention_strategy: Phone discovery → confrontation → fake alibi → witness → cliffhanger arrest or exposure.

novels.title: Kiraye Wala
novels.author: Rahasya Original
novels.novel_logline: A new tenant moves in — the landlord's wife starts getting messages she cannot explain.
novels.story_summary: Lucknow old haveli converted to flats. Tenant Arjun, landlord couple Mr and Mrs Sharma. Missing money, late-night footsteps, affair rumors, murder setup.
novels.retention_strategy: New tenant charm → missing cash → secret meetings → who entered the flat → cliffhanger.
